claims.match_notes: The matched private grade supports enlisted Army classification. The suffix is preserved and the identifier remains private.

person_updates.next_action: Review Box 135 to identify Charles J Collins Jr.'s usable pre-service occupation, employer and Army-to-OSS chronology; the Army occupation value 999 is not used as a substantive occupation.

person_updates.identity_evidence: The exact indexed private identifier selects the sole official Army row named COLLINS GENE. It dates Army entry to 17 August 1942 as a private and carries civilian-occupation value 992.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA OSS index pages 87-88 and complete Army comparison; Charles J Collins Jr and suffix variants; exact-name OSS/CIA, employment, occupation, obituary, institutional, newspaper, current Library of Congress and archival checks.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Cemetery and modern-architect namesakes have incompatible ages or no private-identifier and OSS bridge; occupation value 999 is not promoted into a substantive occupation.
research_attempts.research_notes: Confirmed the identity and enlisted Army classification through the exact private identifier; no pre-OSS employer or usable occupation was found.
research_attempts.next_action: Identify the occupation, employer and Army-to-OSS chronology in Box 135.

research_attempts.query_text: NARA OSS index pages 87-88 and complete Army comparison; exact-name and Eugene variants; OSS/CIA, student, school, employment, occupation, obituary, institutional, newspaper, current Library of Congress and archival checks.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Later Navy, Korean-era, baseball and other Gene or Eugene Collins namesakes lack the private identifier or OSS context; the Army category names no school or employer.
research_attempts.research_notes: Confirmed the exact Army identity and published student status with qualification; did not convert a school lead or later career into an employer.
research_attempts.next_action: Identify the school and Army-to-OSS chronology in Box 135.
